question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (4)
solution:
The correct answer is: **on**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The preposition** "On"** is used to specify days and dates. (पर)

 
 
• **Example:** The meeting is on Monday.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that exams are being administered in many Goa schools on Tuesday.
 
• Hence, the correct preposition to use in the given context is "on&am
